I want to bring up EIP-7907 in light of benchmarks I've done on a mainnet shadowfork performance network, the [current](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/7710f881a33be4a336b32a13839d03be1492b272/EIPS/eip-7907.md) and [proposed](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9910) state of the EIP, the [recent](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1375206178199572562/1385890679598612500) discussions and my thoughts on it (we should ship a code size bump! 😄 👍 )

About fusaka EIP-7907 devnet2 tests : https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/fusaka-devnet-2%40v1.2.0

Have noticed this behaviour on `eip7907_meter_contract_code_size/meter_contract_code_size/contract_reentry.json` test
```
Test is about `to` account with big contract getting called again with CALL opcode.

I had bug here where to gets loaded warm but gas is not spend, and on CALL this account code would be warm.

Would assume that we should we deduct on start (when loading to) but I can't deduce this 100% from test.

Nice test btw
draganrakita — 11:52
Looking at other tests that I am passing, they don't deduct this initial to gas, and on second thought this would introduce even more edge cases. 

So would say that test assumes initial `to` to stay cold. This feels like a bug
```
